Options: sheet name in metadata excel sheet
metadata_sheet.Comment: if metadata file is an Excel file, metadata_sheet is the name of the sheet in the excel file containing the metadata

metadata_filename_column.Comment: column in metadata defining filenames matching filenames in input_filename_column, e.g. File.Name or Run

metadata_encoding.Comment: encoding of the metadata, important if i.e. greek letters are used as in microgram

metadata_sample_column.Comment: column in metadata defining (shorter) sample names for metadata_filename_column, sample names must have a unique mapping to file names

sample_type_column.Comment: IMPORTANT: Needs to be specified for evaluation!!! Metadata column containing the sample type e.g. Sample.Type. If None all samples are used.

sample_type.Comment: IMPORTANT: Needs to be specified for evaluation!!! Identifier of the reference samples for plot generation and easier comparison. e.g. MS-QC. If None all samples are used.

protein_col.Comment: name of the column containing protein IDs in input file and id_mapping

precursor_col.Comment: name of the column in input file containing precursors IDs

peptide_col.Comment: Either a column in input_df, e.g. Stripped.Sequence or will be generated from precursor_col by stripping charge state and named as defined with peptide_col

input_ids_columns.Comment: column or columns separated by ";" containing (precursor) IDs in input file for intermediate results. You can add additional column names like "Channel" to this

input_origin.Comment: describes the origin of the input file. Up to now only "diann" is implemented. "custom" will be added in the future

filter_proteotypic.Comment: excludes non-proteotypic precursors/run if set to True

filter_by_qvalue.Comment: excludes precursors per run with Q.Value above qvalue_thresh (precursors with Q.Value == qvalue_thresh are kept)

filter_by_global_qvalue.Comment: excludes precursors per run with Global.Q.Value above qvalue_thresh (precursors with Global.Q.Value == qvalue_thresh are kept)

filter_by_gg_qvalue.Comment: excludes precursors per run with GG.Q.Value (Gene Group) above qvalue_thresh (precursors with GG.Q.Value == qvalue_thresh are kept)

filter_by_pg_qvalue.Comment: excludes precursors per run with PG.Q.Value (Protein Group) above qvalue_thresh (precursors with PG.Q.Value == qvalue_thresh are kept)

filter_by_global_pg_qvalue.Comment: excludes precursors per run with Global.PG.Q.Value (Protein Group) above qvalue_thresh (precursors with Global.PG.Q.Value == qvalue_thresh are kept)

filter_by_p_qvalue.Comment: excludes precursors per run with Protein.Q.Value above qvalue_thresh (precursors with Protein.Q.Value == qvalue_thresh are kept)

filter_by_lib_qvalue.Comment: excludes precursors per run with Lib.Q.Value (Library) above qvalue_thresh (precursors with Lib.Q.Value == qvalue_thresh are kept)

filter_by_lib_pg_qvalue.Comment: excludes precursors per run with Lib.PG.Q.Value (Library Protein Group) above qvalue_thresh (precursors with Lib.PG.Q.Value == qvalue_thresh are kept)

filter_by_PEP.Comment: excludes precursors per run with posterior error probability (PEP) above pep_thresh (PEP values equalling pep_thresh are kept)

filter_by_MScorr.Comment: excludes precursors per run with correlation between MS1 and MS2 chromatograms below MScorr_thresh (precursors with Ms1.Profile.Corr == MScorr_thresh are kept)

filter_by_zero_values.Comment: excludes precursors per run which were identified, but could not be quantified, resulting in Abundance = 0

filter_by_evidence.Comment: excludes precursors per run with Mass.Evidence below evidence_thresh (precursors with Mass.Evidence == evidence_thresh are kept)

filter_by_MScorr_evidence_combined.Comment: excludes precursors per run if Ms1.Profile.Corr * 0.5 * Mass.Evidence is below MScorr_evidence_combined_thresh (precursors with values equalling MScorr_eveidence_combined_thresh are kept)

filter_by_precursorcharge.Comment: excludes precursors per run outside a given charge range

alternative_protein_col.Comment: name of the column in input file containing protein IDs to replace missing values in protein_col

expand_precursor_name.Comment: If 1 expands precursor name by another columns entries e.g. Channel for labelling peptides)

on_peptide_list.Comment: Should the normalization be done on a certain list of peptides (only implemented for median scaling)

correct_method.Comment: Method to be used for correction

check_feature_presence_batch.Comment: Check if precursor presence is above presence threshold for each batch. If this is not the case an error is raised and the code will exit. Only implemented for ComBat and Harmony.

filtering_wide_methods.Comment: filter to apply on wide-format data. Multiple filters can be provided seperated by ";" e.g. filter_samples_by_metadata;filter_samples_by_detection_proportion

hierarchical_imputation.Comment: use imputation with different missingness thresholds or per group/batch etc.

replace_zeros_with_nan.Comment: replace zero values in data_df with nan prior to imputation

simple_imputation.Comment: if 1 one imputtion method is used over the whole dataset at once. If 0 different methods for different missingness types, different groups or hierarchies can be defined.

imputation_method_ProtAbsence.Comment: Method to be used for absent proteins

imputation_method_HA.Comment: Method to be used for high-abundant proteins

imputation_method_LA.Comment: Method to be used for low-abundant proteins

imputation_method_ProtAbsenceHA.Comment: Method to be used for absent but in other samples low abundant proteins

imputation_method_ProtAbsenceLA.Comment: Method to be used for absent but in other samples high abundant proteins

eval_missingness_on_protein_presence.Comment: if 1 evaluate missingness by protein presence: if no precursor of the same protein is found, all precursors of this protein in that sample are missing by ProtAbsence

remember_missingness_type_in_mask.Comment: if 0: saves in filter mask whether a precursor was imputed with a decimal number as described in mask description; if 1: same as if 0, additionally this decimal number specifies the missingness type (protein absence, HA, LA)

eval_missingness_by_detection_threshold.Comment: if 1: evaluate missingness (HA/LA) by modelling precursor completeness over intensity

save_intermediate_output_for_QA.Comment: if 1: saves following intermediate output for quality accessment: decision boundaries for intensity dependent missingness estimation, regression plot data for intensity dependent missingness estimation

impute_over_whole_dataset.Comment: if hierarchical_imputation==1 impute_over_whole_dataset==1 imputes over whole dataset after hierarchical imputation

simple_imputation.Comment: use one (1) or missingness type specific method (0)
